reviews.reason: The full selected solution contains a research-level model-construction chain beyond compactness/omitting-types alone: unique C-limit behavior plus definable minima forces every parameter-free relatively definable self-map of p to be an integer successor shift; this rigidity controls two-variable cuts, then unique completion is propagated over arbitrary finite parameter sets; finally that joint-type control defeats every possible isolating formula for an unwanted p-realization when coding an arbitrary countable endless discrete order. The nonstandard burden is the shift-rigidity and finite-parameter uniqueness construction, not merely naming Vaught conjecture or applying the final omitting-types theorem. These core proofs at219–286 are included as obligations, not assumed.
reviews.core_assessment:
shift_rigidity: 219–244: establish surjectivity/injectivity and increasing order behavior via minima; compactness transfers interval preservation to a cofinite tail of C, forcing one fixed successor power.
unique_completion: 246–259: a failure of C-finite satisfiability would yield a definable map jumping below a successor orbit, contradicting rigidity; use a definable convex interval and its minimum to propagate formula truth.265–280 inducts on finite A, separating same-successor-orbit and new-orbit cases.
order_coding: 289–294: embed a successor-closed copy of the desired order; if the omitted type were isolated, minimal parameters come from distinct successor orbits; joint-type uniqueness permits shifting the least unwanted realization down one successor while fixing the parameters, contradicting minimality.
reviews.prerequisite_assessment: Compactness, saturated homogeneity, countable omitting-types, standard cardinality of countable endless discrete orders and elementary order/successor conventions are acceptable standard inputs. DI shift-rigidity and unique-completion statements are not taken as external black boxes: their complete adapted author proofs219–286 were read and included. Parameter-free definable convention is retained at63/92 and is essential: with arbitrary extra parameters a constant p-valued map would defeat shift rigidity.
